title: AgentHeartbeat
description: An agent's liveness heartbeat in the kubemoot_agent_state bucket, key <namespace>.<agent>. An agent is alive while its heartbeat is no older than two of its intervals.

timestamp.description: When the heartbeat was written, RFC 3339 in UTC.

nats.description: Whether the agent is connected to NATS.

ollama.description: Whether the agent's model is ready.

lastInference.description: When the agent last finished a model call, RFC 3339 in UTC. Absent until its first call.
